reviewer.independence_basis: Separate Astra reviewer inspected fixed source, goal, policy, manifest and artifact hashes; rebuilt from a clean git archive and ran tests. No host or external operation.

code_candidate_evidence: Fixed manifest commit and SHA-256 exist and match; fixed source archive matches policy, installer, unit and tokens hashes.
Independent Go 1.25.5 linux/amd64 CGO-disabled archive rebuild with -buildvcs=false -trimpath produced the same binary SHA-256; go version -m confirmed provenance.
Independent go test -race ./... passed all 13 test-bearing packages, including real mock process stop/restart; go vet ./... and installer/listener-smoke bash -n passed.

Fixed unit starts only 127.0.0.1:8787 -mock-worker; mock produces simulation artifacts without model, GitHub or deployment calls. Concurrent isolated mode, non-loopback bind and mock-session release allow are rejected.

Installer rejects occupied dedicated identities, paths, unit and port; verifies hashes after root-protected staging and placement and effective systemd settings before start; creates host-local token without output and preserves dedicated data on failure.
host_install_pending_reasons: Owner and host-use coordination for concurrent k3s stop and libvirt installation are unanswered.
A fresh pre-install host baseline after concurrent work has not been independently reviewed.
Existing tunnel/proxy, global IPv6 and LAN/public reachability have not been disproven; AC-19 and private-ready remain pending.
Linux/systemd host start, stop and recovery have not been performed.
execution_requirements: After coordination and fresh baseline, obtain a separate independent host_install allow decision for the same artifacts, policy and expiry.
Copy the fixed installer to a root-managed path, verify that copy against the fixed install_script SHA-256 and run only the verified copy.
Do not reuse this review after source, artifact, policy, environment, operation or expiry changes.
Measure loopback, LAN, IPv4/IPv6 and existing public paths, event continuity and recovery before private-ready.

limitations.authorization_boundary: code_candidate allow covers the fixed mock bootstrap code only; it does not authorize transfer, installation, real-model execution, notification sending, GitHub operations or public exposure.
